name: Neural Volumes with Multi-Resolution Hash Encoding
aliases: Interactive Volume Visualization Via Multi-Resolution Hash Encoding Based Neural Representation
definition: A neural volume rendering method that uses multi-resolution hash encoding for the neural representation, supporting three decoding paths: decoding into a dense 3D texture, sample streaming (collecting coordinates for host-side TCNN inference), and in-shader inference (fused TCNN inference inside the ray march).
summary: Neural Volumes with Multi-Resolution Hash Encoding is an interactive volume rendering method that compresses data into a neural representation using hash grids and GPU acceleration to achieve real-time performance.
